findings.title: Restore a stackless original error in the no-stack test
findings.trigger: The test 'creates new stack if original error has no stack' now builds `original` with `new Error('original')`, which always carries a stack, so the constructor copies `originalError.stack` and never reaches the captureStackTrace branch; before this change `original` was `{ message: 'original' }`.
findings.impact: A regression in the stack condition at `GraphQLError.js:195`, such as `if (originalError)`, would leave `e.stack` undefined for stackless originals and still pass: the other `.stack` assertions use no original or a real `Error`, and the executor tests that throw strings never assert `.stack`.
findings.change: Make the original stackless again while satisfying Flow, for example `const original: any = new Error('original'); delete original.stack;` (Flow was not run on this suggestion).
findings.source: Commit 7e39a12: "Enable Flow typings on errors tests".
